기본 원리부터 공격에 대응하는 시연과 대련까지 이어지는 과정을 담았습니다.

snippet.title: 박재훈 올림피아 다섯 해 포즈 전환 시간 재 봤습니다
snippet.description:
클래식 피지크 박재훈 선수가 2022년부터 2026년까지 다섯 해 연속 올림피아 개인 포징에서 보여 준 같은 동작 묶음(쪼그려 앉아 손 허리 → 두 팔 펼침 → 스쿼트 백 더블 바이셉스)을 1/15초 간격으로 재 봤습니다.
팔을 편 자세를 풀고 백 더블 바이셉스가 완성되기까지: 2022년 0.33초 · 2023년 0.60초 · 2024년 0.53초 · 2025년 0.27초 · 2026년 0.33초. 다섯 해 모두 1초 안이었습니다.
백 더블 바이셉스를 버틴 시간은 2022년 1.33초, 2026년 0.67초였습니다.
※ 공개 영상을 1/15초 간격 사진으로 보고 잰 값이며, 한 경계마다 ±0.07초 오차가 있습니다. 순위는 올림피아 공식 결과(Fitness Volt 집계) 기준입니다.

화면 출처: YouTube Elly Choi 「2022 Mr Olympia 미스터올림피아 프리저징 개인포징 박재훈」 · 박재훈 본인 채널(Allright24) 「2023 Mr. Olympia Pre-Judging Full ver.(4K)」 · 보매-보디빌딩 매니아 「2024 "클래식 피지크 올림피아" 박재훈 개인 포징」 · TFE Media 「박재훈 클래식피지크 올림피아 4K 하이라이트 및 시합 후 인터뷰」(2025) · 「올림피아 1일차 사전심사 | 박재훈, 홍승찬, 정태민, 안다정」(2026)

Cabinet recommended move due to KP govt’s ‘deliberate disengagement from the fight against terrorism’
Dr Muhammad Fakhr Alam appointed as KP chief secretary
PTI’s Gohar condemns decision as undemocratic, says peace cannot be established by weakening provincial autonomy
Governor Kundi calls for unity for ‘new chapter’ in KP’s development
ISLAMABAD: The federal government on Sunday imposed an emergency and governor’s rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa following the president’s approval of the recommendations by the federal cabinet.

The measures have been approved under Articles 232 and 234 of the Constitution, the President House said in a statement. The two provisions pertain to the proclamation of emergency and governor’s rule.
Following the imposition, internet disruptions were being reported from parts of Peshawar, with Dawn unable to contact its correspondents there. Earlier in the day, massive police deployment and increased barriers on certain routes using containers were witnessed in the city.

According to sources in the telecom sector, mobile network and data services have been slowed or shut down in selected areas of some cities. However, there is no province-wide shutdown of mobile data or internet.

The decision to impose the provisions came during an emergency meeting of the federal cabinet chaired by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, where he was briefed on the security situation in KP.

A statement issued by the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO) said cabinet members reviewed the situation and took note of the “provincial government’s deliberate disengagement from the fight against terrorism”.

The members proposed, given the “gravity” of the situation, that the PM advise the president to exercise “his constitutional authority and impose an emergency in the province under Articles 232 and 234 of the Constitution”.

snippet.title: EDA ECE: “BENİM HIRSIMIN BİR LİMİTİ VAR!”
snippet.description:
YouTube’da yayınlanan, Fatih Altaylı’nın sunduğu Pazar Sohbeti programının son bölüm konuğu Eda Ece oldu. Oyunculuk kariyerinde uyguladığı kuralları anlatan Ece, açık sahnelerde yer almadığını ve dekolte giymediğini söyledi. Fatih Altaylı ise ünlü oyuncuya “Türkan Şoray gibisin” benzetmesinde bulundu.

Eda Ece, Buğrahan Tuncer ile evlendikten ve anne olduktan sonra bu konularda daha da dikkatli davranmaya başladığını belirterek şu ifadeleri kullandı:

“Rol arkadaşlarımı eleştirmiyorum. Bazı oyuncu arkadaşlarım bana kızacak ama onlar yapabilirler, inşallah Oscar alırlar. Ben kimseyi kıskanan biri hiç olmadım. Benim hırsımın bir limiti var, yapmak istediklerimin de bir limiti var.

Hollywood’da da birçok aktris, ‘Ben kendimi fiziksel olarak kullandırtmak istemiyorum’ diyerek açık sahne çekmemeye başladı. Seçeceğim roller de ona göre oluyor. Benden çok, onu barındıran şeyler göremeyecekler. Ben kendi mutlu olduğum işlerle devam edeceğim.”

#edaece #türkanşoray #magazin #keşfet #fatihaltaylı

snippet.description:
Elon Musk vs EVM: is India's electronic voting machine next on Musk's list while Starlink India waits for clearance? My full breakdown and prediction.

In June 2024 Musk said electronic voting machines should be eliminated over hacking risk. Rahul Gandhi called the EVM a black box, and Rajeev Chandrasekhar replied that India's EVMs have no internet connection.

Inside: how an EVM works, BEL and ECIL, ballot unit, control unit, VVPAT slip counting, the Supreme Court verdict on ballot paper, and the Kolkata fire that destroyed around 4,000 EVMs.

EVM tampering has never been proven in court. But with Musk vs Ambani and the Starlink security clearance in the news, this debate is far from over.

EVM or ballot paper? Tell me in the comments.
